item.title: Students from Rigo join Port Moresby Nature Park to celebrate Reverse The Red Day
item.description: As early as 5:00 am this morning, excited students woke up in their village on the Rigo coast to travel with their teachers three hours to Port Moresby to celebrate Reverse The Red Day at the Port Moresby Nature Park. The students from Bina Primary and Elementary School in the Rigo District of Central Province were invited by the park to join the celebrations.
